Why do boosted posts fail to generate real commercial inquiries?

Boost Post Algorithm vs Direct-Response Ads Manager

Boosting posts optimizes for cheap post engagement (likes and comments) rather than conversions. We architect full Ads Manager campaigns targeting purchase intent and direct quotation submissions.

02

How does Inrank overcome iOS tracking limitations on Meta?

+
Server-Side Conversions API (CAPI)

Browser-based tracking misses 20-30% of conversions due to ad blockers and Safari privacy rules. We configure server-side CAPI via Cloudflare/AWS, restoring 100% attribution data to Meta's AI.

The Decision Deploy server-side GTM and Meta Conversions API on your primary domain.
  1. CAPI Gateway Setup
  2. Event Deduplication
  3. Attribution Verification

+
Problem-Agitation-Solution Video & Static Carousel

We test video hooks that address customer pain points within the first 3 seconds, paired with clean typography cards and customer proof screenshots.

The Decision Produce 4-6 creative variants per sprint to prevent ad fatigue.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything business owners and growth leaders need to know before initiating a sprint with Inrank Technologies.

What is the minimum ad spend required for Meta Ads?+

We typically suggest starting with ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per month for local campaigns to test creative angles and train the Meta pixel.

Can Meta Ads work for B2B businesses in Pune?+

Yes. By targeting business owners, specific industry job titles, and remarketing to website visitors, Meta Ads frequently outperform LinkedIn on Cost-Per-Lead.

How often do you refresh ad creatives?+

We review ad fatigue weekly and introduce fresh copy angles and visual creatives every 10 to 14 days.

Do leads go straight to our CRM or phone?+

Yes. We integrate lead forms directly with WhatsApp Business, email notifications, and CRM webhooks in real time.

Who owns the Meta Business Manager and pixel data?+

You retain 100% legal ownership of your Business Manager, ad accounts, and pixel datasets.
